input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever the PUBLIC_URL environment variable isn't set, and passwordResetEmail (and the other email builders) use that BASE_URL to build links. If PUBLIC_URL isn't configured in the production environment (e.g. after last week's release changed deployment config), reset emails will silently link to localhost instead of the real site. The fix is to ensure PUBLIC_URL is set in prod and/or fail loudly instead of silently defaulting to localhost.
